calls.title: GrowthBook Exposure Events
calls.summary: The discussion addressed key aspects of experiment tracking within GrowthBook, emphasizing the importance of a unique and descriptive experiment key to avoid duplication, especially when experiments are repeated. Chris Sanders highlighted that exposure tracking requires a numeric variation ID sourced from the SDK, clarifying confusion in GrowthBook documentation regarding 'experiment ID.' The team explored the interaction between experiments and feature flags, noting that experiments could override flag settings for targeted testing. They also outlined that developers do not need to pre-create feature flags for every experiment, providing flexibility in the development process. Lastly, Chris is set to confirm if the SDK includes a unique experiment ID to facilitate external data analysis.
calls.keywords: Experiment Key, Variation ID, Feature Flag, GrowthBook SDK, Exposure Tracking, Data Analytics
calls.action_items:
**Chris Sanders**
Verify from the SDK/source code if a unique experiment ID (UUID) is exposed alongside the experiment key for use in external data systems to enable precise tracking outside GrowthBook (16:00)
Share the recording of this meeting with Emil Bartholdy for future reference and to support ongoing discussions (41:00)
